ios.desc:
Your personal Video Game release calendar!

Ever wanted to know which games are being released soon in a clean, simple format? 
Got some time off coming up and wanted to know how you might spend some of your time in the next few weeks? 
Wanted some sort of personal reminder to let you know when your most anticipated games are coming out?

Well now you can with Playdate and it's all for free!

- View video game release dates coming out in the next 6 months.

- View video game information such as developers, genres and information about each game!

- Links to trailers for each title!

- Add games to your wishlist to be notified when they release! Never miss another title!

- Search for any game - past, present or future and add them to your wishlist!

- Filter between regions!

- Filter your platforms to only the ones you care about with Pro mode.

- Set a reminder offset to be notified on release, a day before or a week before with Pro mode.

- Use lite mode to speed up performance and limit animation intensity on your device.



Regions supported:
  - United Kingdom
  - USA
  - Japan 
  - Australia

Platforms Supported for filtering:
  - PC
  - Mac
  - Linux
  - Google Stadia
  - Playstation 5
  - Playstation 4
  - Playstation 3
  - Xbox One
  - Xbox Series X
  - Xbox Series X|S
  - Nintendo Switch
  - iPhone

quotes.text:
I created Play Date originally as a web app to help me view release dates for games I was interested in. It got pretty popular with some Kotaku and other online articles being written about it.

A lot of the user feedback was regarding an app, so I made an app!

It's free and it may be useful for you!

You can set the region and platforms you're interested in and set yourself reminders for the games on your iPhone or iPad.

Android version coming soon!

App Store Link: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/play-date-video-game-release/id987119779?ls=1&mt=8

Webapp: http://www.chrisgregori.co.uk/playdate/
